outcome: Give saas cto / vp product engineering a governed method to improve gross margin per tenant using tenant usage, cloud billing tags and service telemetry, with final decisions retained by named staff.
overview: SaaS Tenant Cost Attribution addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in technology and saas operations. The first proof of value uses tenant usage, cloud billing tags and service telemetry. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is gross margin per tenant, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: tenant usage, cloud billing tags and service telemetry; define gross margin per tenant and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from SaaS CTO / VP Product Engineering.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for gross margin per tenant
